name: B10-0342/2025 (ECR) – Arbitrary arrest and torture of Belgian-Portuguese researcher Joseph Figueira Martin in the Central African Republic
title: JOINT MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on the arbitrary arrest and torture of Belgian-Portuguese researcher Joseph Figueira Martin in the Central African Republic
part_text:
The European Parliament is not changing any law here. It is speaking out about Joseph Figueira Martin, a Belgian-Portuguese researcher held in the Central African Republic since May 2024. Russian mercenaries arrested and tortured him, and he faces spying charges that could mean life in prison. The Parliament condemns this, demands a fair trial or his release, and asks European diplomats to watch the case and press the authorities.

- **What changes:** Nothing legally. It is a public statement of concern and demands.
- **Who it affects:** Joseph Figueira Martin, his family, and the Central African Republic authorities.
- **What happens next:** EU diplomats are asked to monitor the case and raise it with the authorities.
